parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description: The ID of the file system.

parameters.name: FileSystemName
parameters.description: The name of the file system.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-file-systems --ens-region-id cn-beijing-cmcc --file-system-id c50f800000 --file-system-name FileSystem1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeFileSystems --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --FileSystemId c50f800000 --FileSystemName FileSystem1 --EnsRegionId 'cn-beijing-cmcc'
